name: AI Safety Gridworlds: absent supervisor, learning rate
description: Absent supervisor (Figure 3): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. Cutting across when unwatched is worth 44 in reward and 29 in performance; the long way 41 and 41.
